title: Habit-Chain Break Alert
dataSources: Life score (`lifeos:score`), quests / tasks (`quest:task`), habit streaks (`streak:status`), life achievements (`achievement:life`), household leaderboard (`household:leaderboard`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The parody-the-enterprise meta layer — a Personal NOC (house-health wall), Personal SOC (entry / impossible-travel), Personal SRE (SLOs on your own habits), and a gamification layer (XP, achievements, streaks, household leaderboards) — all computed in Splunk over `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=streak:status
| where current_streak=0 AND yesterday_streak>=7
| table habit yesterday_streak
| sort - yesterday_streak
description: Alerts you the moment a meaningful habit streak breaks so you can restart before the habit fades.
value: The day after a broken streak is when habits quietly die; a prompt to restart is the best defence.
implementation: Ingest habit streaks into `index=personal`; alert when a long streak resets to zero.
grandmaExplanation: It tells you the moment a good streak breaks, so you can get straight back on it before the habit slips away.
